title: MedCLIP
paper_title: MedCLIP: Contrastive Learning from Unpaired Medical Images and Text
core_mech: MedCLIP 的关键不是更深双塔，而是用医学知识构造任意图像—文本间的软语义配对。
core_mech_en: Replaces hard binary 1-to-1 image–report pairing with a soft semantic similarity matrix derived from clinical entity extraction, enabling unpaired contrastive learning.
input_desc: 可分别采样的胸片与报告句子，以及图像标签和文本实体
input_en: Independently sampled chest radiographs and clinical report sentences with extracted UMLS/CheXpert entities
output_desc: 医学图像/文本共享 embedding、零样本分类与检索相似度
output_en: Shared medical image–text embeddings and zero-shot disease probabilities
